# Lantern

Installs the sample lantern tool into a dev container.

## Example usage

```json
"features": {
  "ghcr.io/example-org/features/lantern:1": {}
}
```

## Options

| Options Id | Description | Type | Default Value |
|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| version | Version to install. | string | latest |

## Notes

The feature installs the tool for every user in the container.
